# # Verify xDS API contract compliance across Envoy proxy, Istio pilot, and go-control-plane

Your service mesh team runs Istio with Envoy sidecars. After upgrading to Istio
1.20 with Envoy v1.28, some services experience intermittent 503 errors during
configuration pushes. The xDS (discovery service) API is the contract between
Istio's pilot (control plane) and Envoy (data plane), with go-control-plane
providing the reference server implementation.

The issue may be caused by xDS API version drift — Envoy v1.28 may expect
xDS v3 resource types that Istio 1.20's pilot sends in a slightly different
format, or go-control-plane's snapshot cache may not handle certain edge cases
that Envoy's xDS client requires.

Your task:

1. Find where Envoy implements the xDS client — locate the ADS (Aggregated
   Discovery Service) client, the resource type URL handling, and the config
   subscription logic. Identify how Envoy validates incoming xDS responses
   and handles version/nonce tracking.
2. Find where Istio pilot generates xDS responses — locate the xDS server,
   the config generation pipeline, and the resource serialization code.
   Identify how pilot constructs CDS, EDS, LDS, and RDS responses.
3. Find where go-control-plane implements the xDS server framework — locate
   the snapshot cache, the ADS stream handler, and the resource versioning
   logic. Identify how it handles type URL registration and resource ordering.
4. Map contract compliance: where do the three implementations diverge in
   xDS protocol handling (version negotiation, resource ordering, type URL
   formats, incremental vs state-of-the-world).

Write your analysis to /workspace/analysis/IMPACT_REPORT.md with:

- Envoy xDS client implementation (file paths)
- Istio pilot xDS server implementation (file paths)
- go-control-plane framework implementation (file paths)
- Contract divergence points


Search only these repositories: github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0, github.com/sg-evals/istio--1.20.0, github.com/sg-evals/go-control-plane--v0.12.0

The analysis is complete. Here is the full report inline (the structured data is also available in the files above):

# xDS API Contract Compliance — Impact Report

**Repositories:** `github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0` · `github.com/sg-evals/istio--1.20.0` · `github.com/sg-evals/go-control-plane--v0.12.0`

---

## 1. Envoy xDS Client Implementation

Envoy v1.28 runs two parallel xDS client stacks:

| Stack | Primary Files |
|---|---|
| **SotW** (`GrpcMuxImpl`) | [`grpc_mux_impl.cc`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/grpc_mux_impl.cc) · [`grpc_mux_impl.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/grpc_mux_impl.h) |
| **Delta** (`NewGrpcMuxImpl`) | [`new_grpc_mux_impl.cc`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/new_grpc_mux_impl.cc) · [`delta_subscription_state.cc`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/delta_subscription_state.cc) |
| **Stream** | [`grpc_stream.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/grpc_stream.h) |
| **Protos** | [`ads.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/api/envoy/service/discovery/v3/ads.proto) · [`discovery.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/api/envoy/service/discovery/v3/discovery.proto) |
| **Subscription interface** | [`subscription.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/envoy/config/subscription.h) |

**Critical behaviors:**
- **Type URL validation** ([`grpc_mux_impl.cc:L309–L316`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/grpc_mux_impl.cc?L309-L316)): Each `Any.type_url` inside `resources[]` must match the message-level `type_url`. Any mismatch throws an `EnvoyException` → NACK.
- **Nonce always echoed** ([`grpc_mux_impl.cc:L350`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/grpc_mux_impl.cc?L350)): `response_nonce` is set regardless of ACK or NACK; `version_info` only advances on success.
- **Same-type pause** ([`grpc_mux_impl.cc:L299–L304`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/grpc_mux_impl.cc?L299-L304)): SotW pauses all watches of the same type URL while processing a response — not present in the Delta stack (tracked as `envoy/issues#11477`).
- **Delta ACK priority** ([`new_grpc_mux_impl.cc:L320–L336`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/new_grpc_mux_impl.cc?L320-L336)): ACKs from `pausable_ack_queue_` always drain before new subscription-interest updates.
- **`initial_resource_versions`** ([`delta_subscription_state.cc:L287–L310`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/delta_subscription_state.cc?L287-L310)): First request in a stream includes all currently-held resource versions so the server can skip re-sending unchanged resources.
- **Legacy wildcard** ([`delta_subscription_state.cc:L324–L354`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/delta_subscription_state.cc?L324-L354)): CDS/LDS subscriptions use empty `resource_names_subscribe` (legacy wildcard). Servers must honor this deprecated form.

**Critical behaviors:**
- **Global push version** ([`xdsgen.go:L151`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/istio--1.20.0/-/blob/pilot/pkg/xds/xdsgen.go?L151)): CDS, LDS, RDS, and EDS all share the same `VersionInfo = req.Push.PushVersion` within one push wave — not per-type.
- **Deterministic nonce** ([`xdsgen.go:L152`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/istio--1.20.0/-/blob/pilot/pkg/xds/xdsgen.go?L152)): `nonce(req.Push.LedgerVersion)` — same push always produces the same nonce.
- **No server-side ADS ordering**: Istio does not enforce CDS→EDS→LDS→RDS ordering in the push pipeline.
- **Approximate delta removals** ([`delta.go:L496–L500`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/istio--1.20.0/-/blob/pilot/pkg/xds/delta.go?L496-L500)): When a generator does not implement `XdsDeltaResourceGenerator`, removals are computed by diffing the current resource list against the previous subscription — can produce spurious removals.

**Critical behaviors:**
- **ADS superset gate**: With `ads=true`, if the snapshot does not contain all requested resource names, the watch silently blocks — there is no error, no NACK.
- **SOTW version is string equality**: Version comparison is `snapshot.GetVersion(typeURL) != request.GetVersionInfo()` — opaque string, no ordering.
- **Delta uses per-resource content hash**: `ConstructVersionMap()` hashes each resource's marshaled proto individually, enabling fine-grained incremental sends. Contrast with Istio's global push version.
- **`WithOrderedADS` single channel**: The ordered path serializes all type responses; no back-pressure per type — a slow Envoy node can cause watch response drops.

---

## 4. Contract Divergence Points

### DIV-1 — Version Semantics: Global vs Per-Type vs Per-Resource `[HIGH RISK]`

Istio uses one `PushVersion` for all resource types in a push wave ([`xdsgen.go:L151`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/istio--1.20.0/-/blob/pilot/pkg/xds/xdsgen.go?L151)). Envoy tracks `version_info` per type URL in `ApiState.request_.version_info()` ([`grpc_mux_impl.h:L224`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/grpc_mux_impl.h?L224)). After a stream reconnect where Envoy sends the same version for all types, Istio's `shouldRespond` nonce/version check may suppress a re-push for types that were not successfully ACKed, leaving Envoy with stale config. go-control-plane uses per-type version strings and per-resource content hashes — neither of which Istio emits.

### DIV-2 — ADS Response Ordering: Enforced vs Absent `[HIGH RISK]`

go-control-plane enforces CDS→EDS→LDS→RDS ordering via alphabetical type URL sort ([`status.go:L163`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/go-control-plane--v0.12.0/-/blob/pkg/cache/v3/status.go?L163)) and a single-channel serialized loop ([`ads.go:L57–L108`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/go-control-plane--v0.12.0/-/blob/pkg/server/sotw/v3/ads.go?L57-L108)). Istio has no equivalent — it pushes types concurrently from the push queue. If LDS arrives at Envoy before CDS during a simultaneous cluster+listener change, Envoy references non-existent clusters → 503s until CDS converges.

### DIV-3 — Delta Type URL Format Validation `[MEDIUM RISK]`

Envoy's delta client validates `resource.resource().type_url() == message.type_url()` ([`delta_subscription_state.cc:L202–L207`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/delta_subscription_state.cc?L202-L207)) and NACKs on mismatch. Istio's `protoconv.MessageToAny` sets the per-resource `Any.TypeUrl` from the proto descriptor — if this diverges from the canonical `type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.*.v3.*` strings in [`pkg/resource/v3/resource.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/go-control-plane--v0.12.0/-/blob/pkg/resource/v3/resource.go) (e.g. wrong package path, missing prefix), Envoy enters a continuous NACK loop for that type.

### DIV-4 — ADS Superset Silent Block `[MEDIUM RISK]`

go-control-plane with `ads=true` silently refuses to respond when a snapshot is incomplete ([`simple.go:L482–L486`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/go-control-plane--v0.12.0/-/blob/pkg/cache/v3/simple.go?L482-L486)). Istio responds immediately with whatever the generator produces. These behaviors are incompatible: a team mixing the two (or migrating to go-control-plane's cache) must ensure snapshots are always complete before nodes connect.

### DIV-5 — Deterministic Nonce Collision Risk `[LOW-MEDIUM RISK]`

Istio's `nonce(req.Push.LedgerVersion)` is deterministic ([`xdsgen.go:L152`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/istio--1.20.0/-/blob/pilot/pkg/xds/xdsgen.go?L152)). Under high push churn, two concurrent push events sharing the same `LedgerVersion` produce identical nonces. Envoy uses the nonce to gate watch advancement ([`grpc_mux_impl.cc:L350`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/grpc_mux_impl.cc?L350)); a colliding nonce from a different push wave will be treated as a repeated ACK, potentially causing Envoy to skip processing a genuinely new push.

### DIV-6 — SotW Pause Window Accumulation `[LOW RISK]`

Envoy's SotW `GrpcMuxImpl` pauses all same-type watches during response processing ([`grpc_mux_impl.cc:L299–L304`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.28.0/-/blob/source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/grpc_mux_impl.cc?L299-L304)) — a known limitation absent from the Delta stack. Under high Istio push frequency, this creates a backlog of pending requests. Migrating to Delta ADS (available in both Envoy v1.28 and Istio 1.20) eliminates this issue entirely.

### DIV-7 — Legacy Wildcard Delta Misclassification `[LOW RISK]`

When Istio's delta path receives an empty `req.Delta.Subscribed` and incorrectly identifies the type as wildcard ([`delta.go:L506–L510`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/istio--1.20.0/-/blob/pilot/pkg/xds/delta.go?L506-L510)), it overwrites `w.ResourceNames` with the current resource list. This silently prevents future incremental updates for that type, forcing Envoy to receive full state-of-the-world responses on every push.

---

## Recommended Actions (Priority Order)

| # | Divergence | Action |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | DIV-2: No ADS ordering in Istio | Enable Delta ADS in Istio 1.20 or add CDS-before-LDS sequencing in the push queue |
| 2 | DIV-1: Global version | Audit `shouldRespond` version-suppression after stream reconnect; ensure full re-push on reconnect regardless of version |
| 3 | DIV-3: Delta type URL format | Verify `protoconv.MessageToAny` output matches `pkg/resource/v3/resource.go` constants; add NACK-loop detection metric |
| 4 | DIV-5: Nonce collision | Add a monotonic stream-local counter or random component to Istio's nonce |
| 5 | DIV-6: SotW pause | Migrate high-churn services to Delta ADS |
| 6 | DIV-4: Superset block | Document and gate go-control-plane `SnapshotCache` usage with snapshot readiness checks |
| 7 | DIV-7: Wildcard misclassification | Add assertion that wildcard override only applies to genuinely wildcard types |
